s: Dine haesh beyom tob ubo t' seipim: en motziin haesh lo min haetzim, velo min haabanim, velo min heapar kegon tzepie habbaqar, velo min hammayim shemmeqorbin neoret shel pishtan etzel zekukit lebana melea mayim shemmannichin otah keneged en hashshemesh sheyyachazor noghah lehanneoret vetiddaleq, kol zeh vekayyotze bo asur laasot beyom tob, mippene shehu molid dabar chadash, vedomeh qetzat limlaka, vekevan shehaya epshar laasot meereb yom tob — asur laasot beyom tob. Veim abar veasa — muttar lehishtammesh behaesh beyom tob, shello qanesu chakamim lehaoseh melaka beyom tob kemo sheqqanesu lehaoseh melaka beshabbat hachamura.
En osin pechamin apillu rotzeh lehassiqan tachat tabshilo beyom tob, mippene shehu metaqqen keli, shehare hen reuyim letzorepe zahab. Veod, shehu mekabbeh, shebbaasiyyat happecham nikbeh haesh.

En nopechin bemappuach, kede shello yaaseh kederek shehaumanin osin. Abal nopechin bishpoperet. Vehaolam nohagin hetter bemappuach shel baale battim al yede shinnuy lehappeko milmala lematta, abal bemappuach shel uman asur apillu al yede shinnuy.

Muttar lekassot haesh bikli o beapar mukan kede sheyyishtammer haesh velo yikbeh legamre, veap al pi sheal yede kissuyo epshar shehaesh nikbeh meat, mikkol maqom kevan sheepshar belo kibbuy, ap im nikbeh meat — en bekak kelum, kevan sheeno mitkavven lekibbuy. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshetztzarik lehaesh beyom tob atzmo, abal asur lekassoto kede sheyyishtammer leyom tob sheni, apillu hu rosh hashshana, deen mekinin miyyom tob echad lachabero, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"g.

Derek ose medura gedola laasot arba shurot shel etzim learba ruchot keen arba dopne hatteba, venotenim alehem etzim lemala vedomeh leohel, lepikak harotzeh laasot kak beyom tob — lo yaaseh haddepanot techilla veachar kak yaaseh alehem haggag, mippene shezzehu derek binyan, vaapillu binyan aray asur beyom tob, ella adam echad yeechoz haetzim haelyonim shehem legag beyadayv baavir, veachar kak yesadderu haddepanot tachtehem, kede leshannot midderek chol. Veken im hu mesadder etzim keen gag al gabbe shene abanim haasuyin keen depanot — yeechoz haetzim beyadayv baavir, veachar kak yesadderu haabanim tachtehem. Veken hashshopet et haqqedera al gabbe shene abanim — yeechoz haqqedera beyado baavir, veachar kak yesadder haabanim tachteha, kede shello yaaseh ohel aray beli shinnuy. Veken betzim keshetztzolin otan umannichim echad al gabbe shenayim vehaesh benehem — yeechoz haelyona beyado veyitten haacherot tachteha.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmanniach esh ben shette hattachtonot, shehare hu tzarik laavir shebbenehem, vahare zeh domeh leohel shehu tzarik laavir shettachtayv, abal im en tzarik laavir shebbenehem — eno domeh kelal laasiyyat ohel, umuttar lesadder haelyona al gabbe hattachtona. Velaken muttar lesadder dap hashshulchan al gabbe raglayv ap al pi sheyyesh lahen depanot maggiot laaretz mearba ruchot, kevan sheen tzarik laavir shebbenehen. Veayyen besimman sht"v.

Agudda shel etzim shehudleqa bimdura, kol etz shello achaz bo haur — muttar leshomto min hammedura. Abal otan etzim sheachaza bahen haur — asur lesalleqan min hammedura, shehare hu makchish uran, dikshehen baagudda achat hen doleqin yoter betob mikkeshehen nipradin, vahare zeh domeh limkabbeh. Abal muttar littelan mitztzad echad shel hammedura ulehannichan betzad acher shel hammedura, o lehannichan bimdura acheret, dekevan sheeno mesiran legamre min haesh — eno domeh limkabbeh. Veap shellipamim hen nikbim qetzat qodem shemmachaziran limdura — en bekak kelum, kevan sheepshar belo kibbuy kelal, vehu eno mitkavven lekibbuy. Bammeh debarim amurim sheeno rashshay lahasiran legamre? Beetzim agudim beyachad, o apillu im enan agudim ella shehem etzim daqqim, dikshemmesir echad mehem hu qarob likkabot, abal etzim gassim sheenam agudim — muttar lahasiran legamre min haesh apillu kebar achaza bahen haur. Umikkol maqom, haolam nizharim bekak, veen mesirin legamre min hammedura shum etz sheachaza bo haur. Veken nakon lehachamir.

En somekin et haqqedera velo shum dabar acher bibqaat shel etz, velo hittiru letaltel etzim ella lehassaqa bilbad, lepi shehen omedin umeyuchadin lekak, abal shello letzorek hassaqa — asur letaltelan apillu letzorek gupan umeqoman, mippene sheen alehem torat keli kelal, vahare hen kaabanim sheasur letaltelan shello letzorek "okel nepesh", kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"t. Abal anap etz shehu chad berosho keqotz verauy letoqo betzali kemin shappud velitzlot bo — muttar letaltelo kede litzlot bo, mippene shettashmish zeh domeh lehassaqa, demah li litzlot bo o litzlot begachalto, sheillu haya rotzeh haya massiqo tachat tabshilo. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehu yabesh derauy lehassaqa, abal im hu ratob sheeno rauy lehassaqa beli taarobet etzim acherim veeno yakol litzlot begachalto bilbad — asur letoqo betzali keen shappud. Umikkol maqom, muttar letaltelo lehassiq im etzim acherim ap al pi sheeno rauy lehassiq bipne atzmo. Veyesh omerim deetzim yebeshim kevan shehen reuyim lehassaqa — hare hen mukanim leyom tob veen alehem din muqtzeh, umuttar letaltelan apillu shello letzorek hassaqa veshello letzorek tzeliyya. Abal etz ratob sheeno rauy lehassaqa bipne atzmo raq al yede taarobet etzim acherim — asur letaltelo apillu letzorek tzeliyya raq lehassiqo im etzim acherim, ukemo shennitbaer. Uleinyan halaka — lekattechilla yesh lachush lisbara harishona, abal im hu sheat haddechaq, kegon shennitzrak lo meod lehishtammesh beetz yabesh — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona.

Asur lebashshel biqdera chadasha shel cheres beyom tob, mippene sheal yede bishshul harishon hen mitchazzeqin umitqashshin umachaziqin mayim betob, vezehu gemar tiqqun asiyyatan, veasur mishshum toledet makkeh bappattish, shehu gemar melaka shel kol dabar vedabar, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"b ayyen sham. Abal muttar lebashshel bikle cheres hammetzuppin sheqqorin (gigelezer"t), lepi shehen machaziqin mayim betob apillu qodem habbishshul harishon, venimtza sheen habbishshul gemar melaktan. Veyesh mattirin lebashshel bikle cheres chadashim shellanu apillu enan metzuppin, lepi shekkol tiqqunan ugemar asiyyatan shel kele cheres shellanu hu betannur shel yotzerim. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir kisbara harishona. Velaken nahagu kesheqqonin qederot chadashot bepesach — mebashshelin bahem paam achat qodem yom tob. Abal bishat haddechaq, kegon sheen lo qederot acherot venimtza batel missimchat yom tob — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona.
